title: Scoped instruction operation input
description: Inputs shared by generated scoped Markdown instruction operations.

target.description: Target repository path; defaults to the current directory.

name.description: Lowercase instruction identity used for scaffold creation.

paths.description: Repository-relative applicability patterns for a new instruction.

task.description: Optional task text used when explaining applicability.

changed.description: Changed or target paths used to evaluate applicability.

items.description: One repository-relative changed or target path.

verbose.description: Whether explanation output includes the compiled instruction program.

source.description: Repository-relative static instruction source used for migration advice.

parent.description: Optional semantic route branch to expand one level.

exact.description: Optional known semantic route leaf to inspect directly.

route.description: One or more existing semantic route leaf identities.

current_work_id.description: Optional exact current-work guard; defaults to the resolved current work.

expected_source_revision.description: Route catalogue source revision returned by discovery.

adaptation_mode.description: Select the explicitly owner-admitted guarded adaptation mode.

adaptation_delta_json.description: JSON object describing one bounded append_guidance semantic delta.

owner_admission_by.description: Human or instruction-owner identity that admitted this exact candidate revision.

dry_run.description: Simulate the admitted adaptation without writing canonical state.
